about:
American Iron Works operates from a shop at 17 Morris Street in New Haven, Connecticut. The business traces its roots back over 40 years to a passion for metal craft held by Pasquale, the father and grandfather of the current owners. Today it is a third‑generation, family‑owned company led by Anthony and Joe Maresca, who have grown the operation into a full‑service fabrication and installation house serving clients across Connecticut.

The company produces custom ornamental metal fabrications in iron, stainless steel, aluminum, and bronze. Its in‑house capabilities span welding (Stick, MIG, TIG), metal forming (grinding, cutting, chamfering, bending, punching, shearing, and CNC plasma cutting), and finishing (sandblasting, powder coating, galvanizing, and patinas). Every project moves through material sourcing, fabrication, finishing, and installation under one roof, with each piece inspected before it leaves the shop.

American Iron Works serves both commercial and residential customers. Commercial projects have included fire‑escape renovations, steel mezzanines, anti‑climb fencing, and custom partition walls for office and retail spaces. Residential work ranges from hand‑forged stair rails and Juliet balconies to aluminum pergolas, cable‑rail systems, and decorative gates. The shop also fabricates specialty items such as sunburst panels, branch‑textured railings, and custom signage.

The Maresca brothers emphasize fine craftsmanship, custom design, and efficiency as the pillars of their reputation. They attribute their longevity to a hands‑on approach that controls every step from raw material to final installation, ensuring each client receives a unique, detail‑oriented piece.
